title: Echocardiography-based machine learning algorithm for distinguishing ischemic cardiomyopathy from dilated cardiomyopathy
summary: Four echocardiography-based models distinguish angiography-confirmed ischemic from dilated cardiomyopathy in 399 patients; XGBoost achieved optimal-subset AUC 0.934 and external-center validation AUC 0.804. This is retrospective diagnostic performance with limited external sample (79).
ai_technology: Random forest, logistic regression, neural network, and XGBoost models
organization: Department of Cardiology, The First Affiliated Hospital of Guangxi Medical University, Nanning, China
